standard-dialogue-before-bone-voyage.npc: We're making the final preparations for our voyage to the distant lands to the North.

options.text: Is there anything I can do to help?

steps.player: Is there anything I can do to help?

steps.npc: We could do with an extra pair of hands, but you're better off speaking to Curator Haig Halen at the Varrock museum if you'd like to get involved.

standard-dialogue-after-bone-voyage.npc: Thanks for all your help, [player name].
